title: Tallowbrook Plumbing books 18% more jobs after leaving Jobber
challenge: At 12 techs, Tallowbrook was adding apps for marketing and reviews on top of Jobber, and after-hours calls went to voicemail.
solution: Switched in nine days during busy season. Turned on online booking, after-hours call routing, and automatic review requests.

quote.text: We stopped paying for three extra apps, and the phone stopped going to voicemail.

title: Brindlewood chose Housecall Pro over a three-month ServiceTitan setup
challenge: ServiceTitan quoted three months to go live. Brindlewood couldn't take the office offline before heating season.
solution: Went live in 11 days, moved 900 maintenance plans over, and added financing to every replacement quote.

quote.text: We were live before the other setup would have started.

title: Copperwren moved off Jobber in a weekend and gets paid in days
challenge: The office manager was worried about switching mid-year and losing open invoices.
solution: Housecall Pro's onboarding team moved 1,400 customers and every open invoice over one weekend.

quote.text: I closed out Friday on the old system and opened Monday on the new one. Nothing got lost.

title: Fernvale grew recurring revenue with service plans and postcards
challenge: Recurring lawn plans lived in spreadsheets, and renewals slipped every spring.
solution: Moved plans into Housecall Pro with automatic renewals, then sent postcard campaigns to lapsed customers.

quote.text: Spring renewals used to take my whole March. Now they just happen.

title: Ridgequill Roofing closes bigger jobs with financing in the estimate
challenge: Big roofing tickets stalled when homeowners had to arrange their own financing.
solution: Added financing offers to every estimate the crew lead shows on site.

quote.text: Homeowners say yes on the driveway now instead of 'let me think about it.'

title: Larchmoor sees profit by crew without a data analyst
challenge: The owner couldn't see which crews and job types made money.
solution: Turned on job costing and weekly crew reports, reviewed in a Monday meeting.

results.label: Weekly reporting, down from a day

quote.text: Monday's report tells us where the money went. We used to guess.

title: Saltmeadow standardized pricing across 28 techs
challenge: Techs priced the same job differently, and the office spent hours fixing invoices.
solution: Built a good-better-best price book that every tech uses on the phone.

quote.text: Every tech quotes the same price now, and customers like having three options.

title: Thistledown Electric adds financing and reviews after leaving Jobber
challenge: Panel upgrades stalled on price, and reviews only came in when someone remembered to ask.
solution: Turned on financing in estimates and automatic review requests after every job.

quote.text: Financing turned 'maybe next year' into 'when can you start.'

title: Bramblewick fills its calendar with online booking
challenge: The owner spent evenings returning calls to book window jobs.
solution: Added online booking to the website and Google profile, with automatic reminders.

quote.text: Customers book themselves at 10 p.m. I just show up.
